headline: Heating Oil at €1.55 per Liter – 20 Cent Cut for Diesel, 10 Cents for Unleaded (Tables)
summary: Government announcements set heating oil to fall 40 cents, road diesel 20 cents and unleaded petrol 10 cents per litre. The heating allowance will rise 30% to address energy price pressures.
why: Fuel and heating costs feed directly into household budgets, transport costs and inflation in Greece, a major Mediterranean energy consumer.
